---
title: "An Introduction to SQL"
subtitle: "Through SQLite" 

---

```{r}
library(DBI)
```

```{r}
mydb <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "course-materials/_db/netflixdb.sqlite")
# dbDisconnect(mydb) # <- run this to disconnect

```

```{r}
# List the tables
dbListTables(mydb)
# We care about: episode, movie, season, tv_show, view_summary
```

```{r}
# Get field summary
dbListFields(mydb, "movie")
# or 
# With Data Types
dbGetQuery(mydb, "PRAGMA table_info('movie')")
#
```
